findings.evidence: T011 implements the prepared-root JDT-LS adapter and T013 composes it using trusted absolute PATH targets in Phase 3, while T022–T023 defer first-match rejection, trusted directory and executable identity checks, replacement protection, and safe batch/interpreter child launch until Phase 6. The tasks do not explicitly close all production-capable launch paths between these phases. An implementer following the listed order could expose the adapter before the accepted fail-closed executable boundary exists.
findings.correction_outcome: Make the launch dependency explicit without changing completed T001–T007 or pending T008: either move T022–T023 before any production-capable JDT launch/composition, or constrain T011/T013 to controlled protocol-only behavior with every real launch path closed until T023. State the checkpoint that prevents real launch and preserve T022/T023 RED/GREEN and T024 real qualification.
